title: ImplementationBrief
description: Implementation brief: the current_understanding, proposed_design, contract_changes, test_strategy, and topo-sortable work_packages fields below. Place these fields directly as the tool input — no outer wrapper.

current_understanding.description: One-paragraph statement of what the repo appears to do today, grounded in repo_context.

proposed_design.description: Concrete technical approach for the change, no pseudocode. Reference repo areas, not file paths.

data.description: Schema or storage changes, or empty.

events.description: Event or message changes, or empty.

test_strategy.description: What should be proven and at what level. Do not pin a test harness.

work_packages.description: Topo-sortable Work Packages. At least one per user story; split a story only when the behaviour or verification predicates are genuinely distinct.

id.description: Stable Work Package id like 'WP-1', numeric suffix starting at 1.

story_id.description: Id of the user story this WP serves, e.g. 'US-1'. A WP names a single story_id.

title.description: Short verb phrase summarising the WP.

intent.description: One behaviour-focused statement of what should change.

verification.description: Observable predicates the Tester and Verifier can check. Describe what the system does, not how to test it. No test framework or harness names.

repo_areas.description: Human-readable areas or flows of the repo to investigate. Required for every WP and should be more useful than a blind file list.

candidate_files.description: Optional repo-relative navigation hints. Not an exhaustive, required, allowed, or forbidden file list. Leave empty when repo_context is not enough to name files confidently.

dependencies.description: WP ids in this same output that should be understood first. Planning context only — does not schedule separate Builder invocations.

notes.description: Short list of risks, assumptions, or compatibility concerns a reviewer should watch.
